title: Add a mechanically bounded runner for one signed GMGN cumulative holdings smoke
objective: Perform a zero-network repair that adds one tracked, auditable runner for the separately authorized one-wallet GMGN signed cumulative holdings live smoke. The runner must validate both approved external input hashes before any child spawn, select exactly the first valid unique strict Base58 32-byte Solana address only in memory, check only credential presence without revealing values, isolate HOME/CWD, set GMGN_RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_RETRY_MAX_WAIT_MS=0 in the actual signed child environment, issue at most one fixed holdings CLI invocation with no cursor, parse only sanitized one-page aggregates, and return only allowlisted diagnostics. Amend the blocked live smoke task to require a fresh independent preflight audit after this repair. This repair itself must make zero network or provider requests and must not read external inputs or credentials.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue any HTTP, HTTPS, RPC, WS, GMGN CLI, or other network/provider request.
Do not read C:\Users\10639\chainfm_out\sol, external address files, cleaned files, GMGN_API_KEY, GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY, .env files, user HOME configuration, or any credential value.
Do not print, persist, commit, fixture, or hardcode a real wallet address, label, credential, credential URL, provider payload, provider stdout/stderr, or full exception text.
Do not modify historical outputs, reports, full-run results, databases, caches, queues, production systems, automation, package manifests, lockfiles, CLI version, or unrelated tasks.
Do not execute the live smoke. Do not use git reset --hard, force push, or delete branches.
deliverables: A tracked bounded runner and CLI entrypoint with dependency-injected file, environment, and child-process seams for offline tests.

Pure synthetic tests proving fail-closed hash mismatch and missing-credential paths make no spawn; one invocation has retry disabled and no cursor; safe parser output and safe error classification discard raw output.
An amended SOL-GMGN-SIGNED-CUMULATIVE-HOLDINGS-LIVE-SMOKE-001 spec which depends on SOL-GMGN-SIGNED-CUMULATIVE-HOLDINGS-LIVE-SMOKE-PREFLIGHT-AUDIT-002, not the failed preflight audit.
